datePolicy: All external source access dates retain 2026-11-06, the original task local date; requests executed on 2026-11-05 UTC. Copy editing is not an external refresh. Hotel lead-ins are undated except the commercial Swansea date-grid indicators; no publication date is invented.
uncertainties: No complete dated accommodation checkout quote: most room tariffs are undated lead-ins; Swansea commercial grid minimums do not establish room type, inventory, taxes or cancellation. Travel Tasmania is not Tourism Tasmania.

AUD 2,600 excludes flights and travel insurance, and is conditional on estimated rooms and five 24-hour rental periods. A sixth period costs another AUD 114.90; with Wrest Point headline substitution spend becomes AUD 2,641.25. Bond needs available credit but is not spend.

Rental assumes over-25 drivers with at least two years licensed experience. Personal licence, entry documents and rental eligibility are not verified. Zero standard-car excess has damage/contract exclusions; the AUD 100 Launceston charge is package-specific, not universal.

Google Maps readings are leave-now observations, not February forecasts or hotel-door routes. Reverse/combined times and buffers are estimates. Cradle Mountain is excluded to avoid an additional 3h30 and 257 km before walking.

Wineglass lookout is uphill Grade 3 with steps, not a flat gentle stroll; beach descent excluded. Cape Tourville is only an alternative when safe, not the same lookout. Weather, fire, closures and wildlife can alter plans.

MONA extras/ferry excluded; ferry from AUD 32 does not establish return fare. Metro bus Saturday timetable unverified. Current attractions and park prices may change; park pass does not cover MONA or Port Arthur.

Marine Farm hours inspected were explicitly winter hours, not confirmed February service. Food, fuel, parking, local driving and visit/airport timings are estimates. Cataract Gorge walk-only zero entry is a budget assumption corroborated through search, not an official tariff guarantee.

Original source register mentions a Swansea raw HTML archive outside the two-file run folder; it was not provided as an attachment here or re-inspected. SourceArtifacts hashes bind the original itinerary and source register actually read. Original run model remains unknown.
editingContract: Reader-first English and Simplified Chinese drafts with complete itinerary, all driving readings, six accommodation comparisons, budget rows, rental/park qualifications and consequential weather caveats. Numeric/date/URL and corresponding table-cell parity retained. Local Markdown/data and generated HTML previews only, using the shared build/check tools. No Review/stars, public attachment promises, external research refresh, source edits, publication or website-repository changes.
